previous_statement: Apply lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope with c_0^cb=c0=W.c0_cb. Its hypotheses hold, and because U and R are nonempty it gives A_U and A_R as extended L^0*epsilon-C*-algebras. Since W.L>=L^0, use the corresponding recorded local ambient bounds epsilon_U,epsilon_R<=W.L*epsilon.
new_statement: Applying lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope does certify that A_U and A_R are extended L^0*epsilon-C*-algebras, so one may name fresh ambient certificates epsilon_U^hat=epsilon_R^hat=L^0*epsilon <= W.L*epsilon. It does not constrain the independently recorded epsilon_U field of the supplied reset state. Indeed, set epsilon=0 in any exact admissible Stage-2 instance and take an exact reset v_U with d_U=0 and unit error 0, but record any epsilon_U=a>0; an exact corner is also an extended a-C*-algebra, and all displayed root reset inequalities still hold, whereas epsilon_U<=W.L*epsilon=0 is false. Therefore the claimed inference, and hence the root contract as written, is false. A valid repair must either assume the supplied local bounds epsilon_U,epsilon_R<=W.L*epsilon (with epsilon_R explicitly supplied) or change the conclusion to fresh named certificates and separately prove d_U and the unit error are controlled relative to the fresh epsilon_U^hat.
